verdicts.reason: A drops every price, so the fare list is gone. City names are scattered as tiny, unreadable fragments at the left and right edges, Berlin and Madrid sit in dark text on the blue panel, the legal line is dark on blue and illegible, and the blue panel doesn't reach the canvas edges. B also breaks the fare list into scattered fragments: Madrid and London have no prices, Rome and Vienna are dark text on blue, Paris and Berlin are cut by the panel edge, and the CTA straddles the panel boundary. B is marginally less bad only because some city–price pairs survive.
